name: NewsMAN SMTP
author: NewsMAN

sections.description:
With support for OAuth-based authentication and secure SMTP account credentials, this plugin offers a reliable and flexible solution for sending emails directly from your website.

Guarantee the prompt and reliable delivery of critical messages, such as order confirmations or shipping notifications, through SMTP. This ensures users consistently receive important communications without delay.

External services

This plugin connects to NewsMAN Transactional API (as seen in KB ) in order to send emails.
For using NewsMAN SMTP the plugin sends From Name and From Email fields along with required API Key and Account ID.
Once the plugin is set up the WordPress wp_mail function will be overriden to use NewsMAN’s SMTP service.
This service is provided by NewsMAN: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Automatically
1. In your WordPress admin panel, go to Plugins > New Plugin, search for NewsMAN SMTP and click \”Install now\”

Manually
2. Download the plugin and upload the contents of newsman-smtp.zip to your plugins directory, which usually is /wp-content/plugins/.
– Activate the plugin – NewsMAN SMTP
– Then you can login with NewsMAN via OAuth and set your SMTP account.
sections.faq:
How do I set up a NewsMAN SMTP account?

To use the plugin you will need to create a NewsMAN SMTP Account.
Set up a SMTP account
